description: Bundled general-capability probe suite for catastrophic-forgetting analysis. Items are original, written for this project; they are not copied from ARC, HellaSwag, MMLU or any other benchmark, so there is no contamination risk from the base model having trained on them, and no licence question. The multiple-choice half is scored by length-normalised log-likelihood over the answer options (no generation, fully deterministic, the same protocol lm-evaluation-harness uses). The instruction-following half is generated and checked by rule, which is what actually detects the most common fine-tuning regression: a model that has learned to always emit a fenced code block.
